item.title: Bike and Gear List
item.description:
I am an over-packer. My loaded bike usually weighs between 110 and 120 pounds. I really wanted to do this tour in a more lightweight fashion, so I started with a titanium Bearclaw Thunderhawk and put smaller panniers on it, using the excellent Tailfin system.
I've never done a test ride on a loaded bike for other tours before this. I figure I can fix anything I run into along the way, but I am really glad I did a test ride on this bike. I learned that the titanium fork is absurdly unstable ev...

item.title: Unfinished Business
item.description:
On September 1, I will take the Amtrak Coast Starliner train to Los Angeles to finish Route 66.
I cut my 2022 tour short in Tucumcari, NM when I got tired of the relentless headwinds, and I am hoping for better conditions this year!
You can read about that tour here .
I plan to reach Tucumcari, NM and we'll see what happens from there.
